settings.label: Who we are
settings.title: Created for athletes
settings.copy: Teknotize Merchandise was built so athletes can launch official merch without becoming a factory, warehouse, or customer-support team. Communities rally behind players — that energy deserves a real store.

settings.label: What we sell
settings.title: Premium drops
settings.copy: Oversized hoodies, heavyweight boxy T-shirts, fleece sweatshirts, washed tees, and long sleeves. Every collection is custom to the athlete. Fans get quality. Athletes get a brand.

settings.label: How we work
settings.title: We handle everything
settings.copy: Design, manufacturing, storefronts, fulfillment, shipping, and support. You pick products and graphics, share your link, and earn. We keep the operation moving worldwide.

settings.label: The standard
settings.title: Built by the game
settings.copy: We work with high school, college, and pro athletes. If you have a name fans want to wear, you belong here. This is just the beginning.

settings.heading: Teknotize Merchandise. Built for Athletes.
settings.intro: We believe every athlete can build something elite on and off the field. Our job is to launch a brand worthy of the work you put in — premium apparel, athlete-owned stores, and fulfillment handled end to end, because success reaches far beyond the scoreboard.
settings.voices_intro: Honest feedback from athletes, fans, and agencies who sell and shop with Teknotize Merchandise.
settings.cta_copy: Join athletes already earning from their name. We handle the hard part — you bring the fans.
